summary: Tencent Cloud TokenHub gives each root account a one-time free trial quota covering multiple model types. Each eligible language model gets 1,000,000 free tokens valid 90 days from claim; the campaign runs through December 31, 2026. TokenHub is an OpenAI-compatible gateway serving DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, MiniMax and other models. Claiming or enabling a model freezes USD 1 of account balance (returned when endpoints are deleted).
claim_steps: Log in to the TokenHub console and activate the platform.
On the Model Gallery page, click 'New User Free Trial', select models, then 'Claim Now'. Free trial can also be auto-claimed on first invocation of a supported model.
Keep a positive balance: USD 1 is frozen per model claim/enablement (released when endpoints are terminated).
Use the quota within 90 days of claiming; unused quota expires.

social_proof.title: New User Free Trial Package — LLM Service TokenHub
social_proof.text: Each language model comes with a free trial quota of 1 million tokens, valid for 90 days. This campaign is valid until December 31, 2026. Each time you claim a free resource package for a model or enable postpaid service for a model, USD 1 will be automatically frozen in your account.
